headline.caveat: unsecured 12-month bridge facility, 21 lenders; JPMorgan and Goldman Sachs lead with Mizuho, SMBC, and MUFG; sub-underwriters incl. HSBC, BNP Paribas, Intesa Sanpaolo

realized_to_date.caveat: estimated: $10B tranches scheduled Apr 1 / Jul 1 / Oct 1, 2026 — first confirmed drawn, the July tranche assumed drawn on schedule, October pending

nature_md: A $40B unsecured bridge facility — SoftBank's largest-ever loan, with lead arrangers JPMorgan and Goldman Sachs alongside Mizuho, Sumitomo Mitsui, and MUFG, sub-underwriters including HSBC, BNP Paribas, and Intesa Sanpaolo, and 21 lenders in total (JPM and GS reportedly earning ~$100M in combined fees). Signed March 2026, 12-month maturity, ~SOFR+250bp (~6.1%). $30B funds SoftBank's follow-on OpenAI investment through Vision Fund 2 (taking planned cumulative OpenAI investment to ~$64.6B by Oct 1, 2026), drawn in $10B tranches Apr 1 / Jul 1 / Oct 1, 2026; $10B is for general corporate purposes. The 12-month unsecured tenor is widely read as lenders underwriting to an expected OpenAI IPO as the take-out.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Unsecured syndicated lending across 21 banks — spreading a record single-name commitment; ~$100M of arrangement fees to the leads. The bridge's repayment path depends heavily on capital-markets events (OpenAI IPO or SoftBank asset sales) rather than SoftBank operating cash flow.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Debt on SoftBank's balance sheet funding an equity investment in a loss-making private company — the archetype of the cycle's debt-funds-equity-funds-compute chain. Sits alongside the $10B OpenAI-stake margin loan (Aug 2026) and follows SoftBank's sale of its entire NVIDIA position to fund OpenAI.

events.title: SoftBank signs $40B bridge with 21 lenders to fund OpenAI stake
